'''Backhand shock gloves''' were a series of powerful, [[Stun/Legends|non-lethal]] [[Shock glove/Legends|shock gloves]] produced by [[Corellian Personal Defense/Legends|Corellian Personal Defense]]. The [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] used an advanced kinetic energy reclamation system to power its high-output circuitry and offered the power and versatility of a [[Stun baton/Legends|stun baton]] in a [[Clothing/Legends|wearable]] form. Because of its power requirements and charging system, which used the wearer's movements to recharge its [[Capacitor/Legends|capacitors]], the gloves were slow to recharge.<ref name="Far Horizons" /> Post-[[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="EotE date">The [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] establishes that ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' takes place after the destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], an event that occurred during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], dated by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> and during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] fought between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Backhand series shock gloves were marketed toward [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]], security forces, and [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] and cost 2,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Far Horizons" />

==Behind the scenes==
Backhand shock gloves were mentioned in ''[[Far Horizons]]'', a [[2014]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="Far Horizons" />
